summary: We are looking for a passionate Software Developer Intern who enjoys building applications, solving technical challenges, and writing clean code. You will work alongside our engineering team on real modules and features that contribute to production-level projects.
responsibilities: Develop, test, and maintain features for web or backend applications
Write clean, efficient, and reusable code in languages like Python / Java / JavaScript / C++
Assist in API development and integration
Work with frameworks such as Django, Flask, Node.js, React, or Java Spring Boot
Debug and troubleshoot software issues to ensure optimal functionality
Collaborate with designers, product teams, and developers
Participate in code reviews, documentation, and release planning
required_skills: Pursuing or recently completed graduation in Computer Science, IT, Software Engineering, or related fields
Strong understanding of programming fundamentals & OOP concepts
Familiarity with at least one backend or frontend framework
Knowledge of Git/GitHub for version control
nice_to_have_skills: Knowledge of API security and software deployment
benefits: Hands-on exposure to real development environments
Work with experienced software engineers and mentors
